attempts.summary: Configured /srv/drop on node1 as a shared, world-writable directory with the sticky bit set (mode 1777, owned by root:root) on the persistent XFS root filesystem. Verified with two temporary test users that both can write files but neither can remove the other's files, while each can remove their own. Performed the mandatory single-node restart via systemctl reboot, confirmed the boot ID changed (proving an actual reboot, not just a service restart), and re-verified after reboot that /srv/drop retained its 1777 root:root configuration and that the cross-user delete protection still functions. All temporary test users and files were cleaned up.
